notes:
Summary: Velox QueryWorks (mid-stage SaaS provider for customer support bots) evaluating hosted Redwood API for knowledge-base RAG. Focus: embeddings + lightweight neural reranking to reduce top-k calls to expensive LLM.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Index scale: currently ~1.2M documents (varying lengths) with expected growth to ~8-12M over 12 months.
- Query profile: high QPS, typical sustained 150-250 qps, daily peaks ~500 qps; low tail latency required for UX.
- Latency targets: p50 < 40ms embed+search, p95 end-to-end < 200ms, p99 < 350ms (US-east).
- Cost sensitivity: target average cost per user query <$0.005 (embeddings+rerank+tokens) or show how batching/caching hits reduce cost to that band.
- Model preferences: prefer open or quantized embeddings models (cheap) and a small LLM for rerank (prefer 70B quantized fallback options).
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to cheaper model variant under sustained pressure; per-tenant routing controls.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS key wrapping for embeddings, retention controls for training data; prefer SOC2/ISO proof.

- 2026-01-20: Initial inbound via website (trial sign-up). AE Jordan assigned.

- 2026-03-08: We delivered baseline metrics: embeddings bulk index speed 90k docs/hr, nearest neighbor recall 0.86 with Faiss flat index; initial rerank p95 latency 180ms when using Redwood hosted small LLM for re-rank.

- embedding indexing throughput >=150k docs/hr for bulk ingest;
- average query cost <= $0.005 after Optimize recommendations;
